text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing together— 
Machikane Tannhauser stopped in front of a 
clothing boutique.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! Struck gold! A hat sale, it's a 
hat sale!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I have plenty of allowance right now, so 
let's definitely go take a peek!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No, no, this baby's still got plenty of 
life left in it! Hehehe, what I actually 
want to buy is~――

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "Ta-ta-ta-daaan! Behold! It's your hat!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hau?! Such a lukewarm reaction?! Why, 
though? Hats are totally amazing, you 
know?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Like being stylish and cute! Or saving 
people in a pinch!
choice_data_list:
I don't think they'd go as far as to help 
us, though...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmh. You're doubting me, aren't you? 
*Ahem*, then I guess I have to tell the 
tale.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: The legend of my—the very first Cap.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
“—The first time I had a hat bought for 
me, yes... was just after I entered 
elementary school.”

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
We went everywhere together. Whether 
taking the train alone, or going to the 
restroom after waking up in the dead of 
night, as long as we were together, it was 
easy peasy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
However... the time of parting came all 
too suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I could never forget that day. My whole 
family had gone on an outing to the forest 
park."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I got a little too carried away that day 
and ended up getting lost in the big park.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
With nobody around, the road grew darker 
and darker... Even so, my spirit didn't 
break. Because... Hat (1st Gen) was with 
me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
However! Heartlessly, a gust of wind blew 
by... and took even my hat, the last 
bastion of my mental composure, right 
along with it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
However... that was precisely the miracle 
worked by the (original) Cap.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The hat soared high into the sky—and lo 
and behold, it flew right toward where her 
parents were!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And my parents figured out where I was 
from the direction my hat blew in from, 
and our family was safely reunited... And 
they lived happily ever after.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Still, no matter how much we searched 
for the hat that blew away, we never could 
find it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure my hat took the fall for me when 
I got lost."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—And! Just like that, hats possess a 
mysterious power! That's the gist of it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So if you wear a hat too, you'll be safe! 
For example, even if you get lost, I'll be 
able to spot you right away!
choice_data_list: Well then, let me get a good one.
Well then, please give me a good one.

Now we don't have to worry even if you get 
lost again.

Now I won't have to worry even if you get 
lost again

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mhfufu, leave it to me. Truth be told, I'm 
a pro at picking hats! I've recommended 
hats to all kinds of people!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Friends, relatives' kids, um, and then the 
neighborhood grandmas and grandpas too! 
I'm a total veteran at this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's take a look! First up is 
this hunting cap—

And so, watching fondly over 
Matikanetannhauser as she browsed through 
hat after hat, the two of us picked out a 
hat together.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Not at all~. I'm certainly not going to 
get lost anymore, and my hat won't go 
flying off either.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Because right now, you put it over your 
ears like this and set it firmly—
Just then, a strong wind suddenly blew—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "Whaaah?! W-Wait up~! Hat-chaaaan!!"

Matikanetannhauser dashed off in an 
instant after her hat... and the call from 
her came several tens of minutes later.

According to her, she got lost and needed 
someone to come pick her up.
